svg.aria-label: Architecture: a new issue, the repository and its code graph go to one offline Gemma 4 triage agent, which writes notes, a reproduction script and a trace. A deterministic orchestrator falls back when notes are missing, computes confidence from agreement with retrieval, finds tests through call edges and re-runs the reproduction; each check fills one field of the final report, which a maintainer reads and can answer with a hint.
svg.title: Gemma 4 Issue Triage: how an issue flows through the system

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How a new issue becomes a checked report: the model investigates, plain code verifies, a person decides.
